- **Sidebar footer widget** — `余额 ¥xx · 今日 ¥xx`, click to o"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"pen a detail card (calls, tokens, per-model breakdown, pricing notes).
- **Peak/off-peak pricing sch"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"edule** — date-gated DeepSeek rate tables (2026-08-17 onward).
- **Full usage dashboard** — per-prov"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ider/per-model calls, latency, TTFT, throughput, input/output/cache tokens, cache rate, and estimate"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"d cost.
- **Call-log analysis** — filter and search by session, provider, and model; inspect recent "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"calls and export filtered rows as CSV.
- **Inherited Stats implementation** — the `usageDashboard` s"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ession projection, 500-row call-log cap, whole-session model aggregates, and replay-safe historical "},{"id":"p9s10","text":"statistics are included in Plus.
